I.value_zh: ADR-0033 working-tree 产物、git status、11 文件 commit #1 白名单、3 文件 commit #2 白名单和五类 untracked 噪音。
I.value_en: ADR-0033 working-tree artifacts, git status, 11-file commit #1 whitelist, 3-file commit #2 whitelist, and five untracked-noise classes.
I.notes_zh: 不查看或修改实际 Git 状态。
I.notes_en: Actual Git state is neither inspected nor modified.

O.value_zh: 两个本地 atomic commit、REPORT-008、TASK-008 archive、两 hash 与范围外噪音处置建议。
O.value_en: Two local atomic commits, REPORT-008, TASK-008 archive, two hashes, and advice for out-of-scope noise.

A.value_zh: 写 task、精确 git add/commit #1、写 report、archive task、精确 git add/commit #2。
A.value_en: Write task, precise git add/commit #1, write report, archive task, precise git add/commit #2.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 提案，ME 执行；tag/push/PyPI 需 ADMIN 二次确认且不在本任务。
P.value_en: ADMIN proposes and ME executes; tag/push/PyPI need ADMIN second confirmation and are out of scope.

R.value_zh: 原文未给出本任务的执行时限或资源预算；P1/low 是优先级和风险标记，两个提交、11/3 文件白名单及五类残留属于交付范围与完成条件。
R.value_en: No execution deadline or resource budget is stated; P1/low are priority and risk labels, while the two commits, 11/3-file whitelists, and five remaining noise classes define deliverables and completion.
R.notes_zh: 数量和白名单仍保留在交付、完成条件与形式模型；不补造 hash。
R.notes_en: Counts and whitelists remain in deliverables, completion, and the formal model; no hash is fabricated.

V.value_zh: ADR-0033、Rule 0.a.1/0.b/0.c/5/7/7.5、codeflow atomic commit 范式和 fcop 1.6.0。
V.value_en: ADR-0033, Rules 0.a.1/0.b/0.c/5/7/7.5, codeflow atomic-commit pattern, and fcop 1.6.0.

C.value_zh: 两个 hash 入 REPORT、仅五类范围外 untracked、规范 commit message、不得 tag/push。
C.value_en: Both hashes in REPORT, only five out-of-scope untracked classes, conforming commit messages, and no tag/push.
C.notes_zh: DoD 非完成事实；REPORT-008 被纳入 commit #2，却同时要求记录 commit #2 的最终哈希，形成未解决的自引用。
C.notes_en: DoD is not completion fact; REPORT-008 is in commit #2 yet must record commit #2's final hash, creating unresolved self-reference.

B.value_zh: 不得加入五类噪音、改 TASK-006/REPORT-007/ADR-0033 内容、打 tag、push、发布 PyPI 或向根写业务代码。
B.value_en: Do not add five noise classes, alter TASK-006/REPORT-007/ADR-0033 content, tag, push, publish PyPI, or write business code at root.
B.notes_zh: 本地 commit 也仅为任务动作，非本审定行为。
B.notes_en: Local commits are task actions, not adjudication behavior.
